paragraphs.text: Paul, called [to be] an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
paragraphs.original: Παῦλος κλητὸς ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ καὶ Σωσθένης ὁ ἀδελφὸς
paragraphs.translit: Paulos klētos apostolos Christou Iēsou dia thelēmatos theou kai Sōsthenēs ho adelphos

paragraphs.text: unto the church of God which is at Corinth, [even] them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called [to be] saints, with all that call upon the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, their [Lord] and ours:
paragraphs.original: τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ, ἡγιασμένοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, τῇ οὔσῃ ἐν Κορίνθῳ, κλητοῖς ἁγίοις, σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐπικαλουμένοις τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ αὐτῶν καὶ ἡμῶν·
paragraphs.translit: tē ekklēsia tou theou, hēgiasmenois en Christō Iēsou, tē ousē en Korinthō, klētois hagiois, syn pasin tois epikaloumenois to onoma tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou en panti topō autōn kai hēmōn·

paragraphs.text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: charis hymin kai eirēnē apo theou patros hēmōn kai kyriou Iēsou Christou.

paragraphs.text: I thank my God always concerning you, for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus;
paragraphs.original: Εὐχαριστῶ τῷ θεῷ μου πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῇ χάριτι τοῦ θεοῦ τῇ δοθείσῃ ὑμῖν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: Eucharistō tō theō mou pantote peri hymōn epi tē chariti tou theou tē dotheisē hymin en Christō Iēsou,

paragraphs.text: that in everything ye were enriched in him, in all utterance and all knowledge;
paragraphs.original: ὅτι ἐν παντὶ ἐπλουτίσθητε ἐν αὐτῷ, ἐν παντὶ λόγῳ καὶ πάσῃ γνώσει,
paragraphs.translit: hoti en panti eploutisthēte en autō, en panti logō kai pasē gnōsei,

paragraphs.text: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
paragraphs.original: καθὼς τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐβεβαιώθη ἐν ὑμῖν,
paragraphs.translit: kathōs to martyrion tou Christou ebebaiōthē en hymin,

paragraphs.text: so that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ;
paragraphs.original: ὥστε ὑμᾶς μὴ ὑστερεῖσθαι ἐν μηδενὶ χαρίσματι, ἀπεκδεχομένους τὴν ἀποκάλυψιν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: hōste hymas mē hystereisthai en mēdeni charismati, apekdechomenous tēn apokalypsin tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou·

paragraphs.text: who shall also confirm you unto the end, [that ye be] unreproveable in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: ὃς καὶ βεβαιώσει ὑμᾶς ἕως τέλους ἀνεγκλήτους ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hos kai bebaiōsei hymas heōs telous anenklētous en tē hēmera tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou.

paragraphs.text: God is faithful, through whom ye were called into the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
paragraphs.original: πιστὸς ὁ θεὸς διʼ οὗ ἐκλήθητε εἰς κοινωνίαν τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: pistos ho theos diʼ hou eklēthēte eis koinōnian tou hyiou autou Iēsou Christou tou kyriou hēmōn.

paragraphs.text: Now I beseech you, brethren, through the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing and [that] there be no divisions among you; but [that] ye be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
paragraphs.original: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, διὰ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἵνα τὸ αὐτὸ λέγητε πάντες, καὶ μὴ ᾖ ἐν ὑμῖν σχίσματα, ἦτε δὲ κατηρτισμένοι ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ νοῒ καὶ ἐν τῇ αὐτῇ γνώμῃ.
paragraphs.translit: Parakalō de hymas, adelphoi, dia tou onomatos tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou hina to auto legēte pantes, kai mē ē en hymin schismata, ēte de katērtismenoi en tō autō noi kai en tē autē gnōmē.

paragraphs.text: For it hath been signified unto me concerning you, my brethren, by them [that are of the household] of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.
paragraphs.original: ἐδηλώθη γάρ μοι περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί μου, ὑπὸ τῶν Χλόης ὅτι ἔριδες ἐν ὑμῖν εἰσιν.
paragraphs.translit: edēlōthē gar moi peri hymōn, adelphoi mou, hypo tōn Chloēs hoti erides en hymin eisin.

paragraphs.text: Now this I mean, that each one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos: and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.
paragraphs.original: λέγω δὲ τοῦτο ὅτι ἕκαστος ὑμῶν λέγει· Ἐγὼ μέν εἰμι Παύλου, Ἐγὼ δὲ Ἀπολλῶ, Ἐγὼ δὲ Κηφᾶ, Ἐγὼ δὲ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: legō de touto hoti hekastos hymōn legei· Egō men eimi Paulou, Egō de Apollō, Egō de Kēpha, Egō de Christou.

paragraphs.text: Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized into the name of Paul?
paragraphs.original: μεμέρισται ὁ Χριστός; μὴ Παῦλος ἐσταυρώθη ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, ἢ εἰς τὸ ὄνομα Παύλου ἐβαπτίσθητε;
paragraphs.translit: memeristai ho Christos; mē Paulos estaurōthē hyper hymōn, ē eis to onoma Paulou ebaptisthēte;

paragraphs.text: I thank God that I baptized none of you, save Crispus and Gaius;
paragraphs.original: εὐχαριστῶ ὅτι οὐδένα ὑμῶν ἐβάπτισα εἰ μὴ Κρίσπον καὶ Γάϊον,
paragraphs.translit: eucharistō hoti oudena hymōn ebaptisa ei mē Krispon kai Gaion,

paragraphs.text: lest any man should say that ye were baptized into my name.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα μή τις εἴπῃ ὅτι εἰς τὸ ἐμὸν ὄνομα ἐβαπτίσθητε·
paragraphs.translit: hina mē tis eipē hoti eis to emon onoma ebaptisthēte·

paragraphs.text: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
paragraphs.original: ἐβάπτισα δὲ καὶ τὸν Στεφανᾶ οἶκον· λοιπὸν οὐκ οἶδα εἴ τινα ἄλλον ἐβάπτισα.
paragraphs.translit: ebaptisa de kai ton Stephana oikon· loipon ouk oida ei tina allon ebaptisa.

paragraphs.text: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not in wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made void.
paragraphs.original: οὐ γὰρ ἀπέστειλέν με Χριστὸς βαπτίζειν ἀλλὰ εὐαγγελίζεσθαι, οὐκ ἐν σοφίᾳ λόγου, ἵνα μὴ κενωθῇ ὁ σταυρὸς τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ou gar apesteilen me Christos baptizein alla euangelizesthai, ouk en sophia logou, hina mē kenōthē ho stauros tou Christou.

paragraphs.text: For the word of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us who are saved it is the power of God.
paragraphs.original: Ὁ λόγος γὰρ ὁ τοῦ σταυροῦ τοῖς μὲν ἀπολλυμένοις μωρία ἐστίν, τοῖς δὲ σῳζομένοις ἡμῖν δύναμις θεοῦ ἐστιν.
paragraphs.translit: Ho logos gar ho tou staurou tois men apollymenois mōria estin, tois de sōzomenois hēmin dynamis theou estin.

paragraphs.text: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, And the discernment of the discerning will I bring to nought.
paragraphs.original: γέγραπται γάρ· Ἀπολῶ τὴν σοφίαν τῶν σοφῶν, καὶ τὴν σύνεσιν τῶν συνετῶν ἀθετήσω.
paragraphs.translit: gegraptai gar· Apolō tēn sophian tōn sophōn, kai tēn synesin tōn synetōn athetēsō.

paragraphs.text: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?
paragraphs.original: ποῦ σοφός; ποῦ γραμματεύς; ποῦ συζητητὴς τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου; οὐχὶ ἐμώρανεν ὁ θεὸς τὴν σοφίαν τοῦ κόσμου;
paragraphs.translit: pou sophos; pou grammateus; pou syzētētēs tou aiōnos toutou; ouchi emōranen ho theos tēn sophian tou kosmou;

paragraphs.text: For seeing that in the wisdom of God the world through its wisdom knew not God, it was God`s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save them that believe.
paragraphs.original: ἐπειδὴ γὰρ ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἔγνω ὁ κόσμος διὰ τῆς σοφίας τὸν θεόν, εὐδόκησεν ὁ θεὸς διὰ τῆς μωρίας τοῦ κηρύγματος σῶσαι τοὺς πιστεύοντας.
paragraphs.translit: epeidē gar en tē sophia tou theou ouk egnō ho kosmos dia tēs sophias ton theon, eudokēsen ho theos dia tēs mōrias tou kērygmatos sōsai tous pisteuontas.

paragraphs.text: Seeing that Jews ask for signs, and Greeks seek after wisdom:
paragraphs.original: ἐπειδὴ καὶ Ἰουδαῖοι σημεῖα αἰτοῦσιν καὶ Ἕλληνες σοφίαν ζητοῦσιν·
paragraphs.translit: epeidē kai Ioudaioi sēmeia aitousin kai Hellēnes sophian zētousin·

paragraphs.text: but we preach Christ crucified, unto Jews a stumblingblock, and unto Gentiles foolishness;
paragraphs.original: ἡμεῖς δὲ κηρύσσομεν Χριστὸν ἐσταυρωμένον, Ἰουδαίοις μὲν σκάνδαλον ἔθνεσιν δὲ μωρίαν,
paragraphs.translit: hēmeis de kēryssomen Christon estaurōmenon, Ioudaiois men skandalon ethnesin de mōrian,

paragraphs.text: but unto them that are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.
paragraphs.original: αὐτοῖς δὲ τοῖς κλητοῖς, Ἰουδαίοις τε καὶ Ἕλλησιν, Χριστὸν θεοῦ δύναμιν καὶ θεοῦ σοφίαν.
paragraphs.translit: autois de tois klētois, Ioudaiois te kai Hellēsin, Christon theou dynamin kai theou sophian.

paragraphs.text: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι τὸ μωρὸν τοῦ θεοῦ σοφώτερον τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐστίν, καὶ τὸ ἀσθενὲς τοῦ θεοῦ ἰσχυρότερον τῶν ἀνθρώπων.
paragraphs.translit: hoti to mōron tou theou sophōteron tōn anthrōpōn estin, kai to asthenes tou theou ischyroteron tōn anthrōpōn.

paragraphs.text: For behold your calling, brethren, that not many wise after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, [are called]:
paragraphs.original: Βλέπετε γὰρ τὴν κλῆσιν ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί, ὅτι οὐ πολλοὶ σοφοὶ κατὰ σάρκα, οὐ πολλοὶ δυνατοί, οὐ πολλοὶ εὐγενεῖς·
paragraphs.translit: Blepete gar tēn klēsin hymōn, adelphoi, hoti ou polloi sophoi kata sarka, ou polloi dynatoi, ou polloi eugeneis·

paragraphs.text: but God chose the foolish things of the world, that he might put to shame them that are wise; and God chose the weak things of the world, that he might put to shame the things that are strong;
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ τὰ μωρὰ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελέξατο ὁ θεός, ἵνα καταισχύνῃ τοὺς σοφούς, καὶ τὰ ἀσθενῆ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελέξατο ὁ θεός, ἵνα καταισχύνῃ τὰ ἰσχυρά,
paragraphs.translit: alla ta mōra tou kosmou exelexato ho theos, hina kataischynē tous sophous, kai ta asthenē tou kosmou exelexato ho theos, hina kataischynē ta ischyra,

paragraphs.text: and the base things of the world, and the things that are despised, did God choose, [yea] and the things that are not, that he might bring to nought the things that are:
paragraphs.original: καὶ τὰ ἀγενῆ τοῦ κόσμου καὶ τὰ ἐξουθενημένα ἐξελέξατο ὁ θεός, τὰ μὴ ὄντα, ἵνα τὰ ὄντα καταργήσῃ,
paragraphs.translit: kai ta agenē tou kosmou kai ta exouthenēmena exelexato ho theos, ta mē onta, hina ta onta katargēsē,

paragraphs.text: that no flesh should glory before God.
paragraphs.original: ὅπως μὴ καυχήσηται πᾶσα σὰρξ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hopōs mē kauchēsētai pasa sarx enōpion tou theou.

paragraphs.text: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who was made unto us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption:
paragraphs.original: ἐξ αὐτοῦ δὲ ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, ὃς ἐγενήθη σοφία ἡμῖν ἀπὸ θεοῦ, δικαιοσύνη τε καὶ ἁγιασμὸς καὶ ἀπολύτρωσις,
paragraphs.translit: ex autou de hymeis este en Christō Iēsou, hos egenēthē sophia hēmin apo theou, dikaiosynē te kai hagiasmos kai apolytrōsis,

paragraphs.text: that, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα καθὼς γέγραπται· Ὁ καυχώμενος ἐν κυρίῳ καυχάσθω.
paragraphs.translit: hina kathōs gegraptai· Ho kauchōmenos en kyriō kauchasthō.
